entities.summary: Ernesto Antonio Mejía Alvarado [meh-HEE-ah] is a Venezuelan former professional baseball first baseman. Listed at 6' 5", 245 lb., he bats and throws right handed. He has previously played in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Saitama Seibu Lions.
